title: App Router prefetch race on hover (server)
body: Repro: hovering Link rapidly during navigation causes the server router cache to return stale entries. The race lives in packages/next/src/server/router.ts where a second prefetch starts before the first resolves. Expected: the second prefetch should either coalesce with the first or invalidate the stale cache key.

top_comment.body: Confirmed on 14.2. The race lives in packages/next/src/server/router.ts -- second prefetch starts before the first resolves and the cache key is reused.

title: useFormState client hook leaks state across navigations
body: On the client, useFormState retains form state when the user navigates away and back. The leak is reproducible with two adjacent routes both using useFormState. Suspect: the action dispatcher in packages/next/src/client/components/use-form-state.ts holds a stale reference after route change.

title: Build manifest path resolution breaks on Windows
body: On Windows, the build pipeline emits backslash-separated paths in the build manifest, which then fail to load on Linux runtimes. The path normalization in packages/next/src/build/webpack-config.ts should always produce posix-style paths.
